name: Tags
author: wizard
description: Channels become tags: a chat can carry several, so a philosophy chat can also sit in your WizardOS tag. Hold a chat and tap Tags… to add or remove them (the sheet stays open), your agent adds the tag that fits, and #philosopher said to the orb tags that chat. Tapping a tag in the Tags tab opens the same channel view as today, and Archived opens your archived chats. Read by the Agent Service (wizard-agent-service issue 608); off, every chat shows in its first tag's channel as today.
